A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the synergistic approach based on the MSS method is able to improve the quality of individual L2 data, especially in the case of the MARSCHALS measurements, while the (L1  + L2) approach does not provide any improvement.
the synergy between MARSCHALS and MIPAS- STR measurements is a real and valuable opportunity for the retrieval of minor atmospheric constituents and temperature profiles.
the MSS method is a promising approach for data fusion of MIPAS- STR and MARSCH ALS observations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synergistic retrieval of atmospheric composition and temperatures using MSS is feasible, but the (L1 L2) approach remains more accurate.
synergistic inversion of L1 data from MARSCHALS and MIPAS- STR is possible, but it requires further investigation.

, although the MSS method is more computationally demanding, it provides more accurate results than the (L1  + L1) approach, in terms of total error, number of degrees of freedoms, relative information distribution and synergy factor.
